versions.changelog: Composio para buscar (Tavily y Apify) con comandos exactos en f100k-puente, actores con virgulilla y reglas de evidencia
La skill puente ahora se llama f100k-puente

Initial release: Autopilot F100K’s weekly content calendar skill for TikTok niches.

- Runs every Monday, finds top 7 viral TikToks from user’s niche for the past week.
- Generates a 7-day calendar, writing ready-to-use video scripts for each day based on proven F100K formulas, and exports results in CSV/XLSX.
- Pulls references from local idea banks and Apify TikTok (if available); organizes by content type for each weekday.
- Sends a detailed summary and download links via email, including an actionable insight based on the week’s viral trends.
- Requires initial configuration in `cerebro/f100k-config.json` before use.
